paper_title: Limits on new long range nuclear spin-dependent forces set with a K-3He co-magnetometer
notes: Search for anomalous neutron spin-dependent forces with K-3He co-magnetometer and 3He spin source at ~50 cm. Main result: pseudoscalar neutron coupling (g_n^p)^2/(4pi) < 5.8e-10 for massless boson (1-sigma), shown vs boson mass in Fig 4 (x-axis in meV). Values emitted are (g_p^n)^2/(4pi), NOT the standard dimensionless g_an; downstream must take sqrt(4pi*value) to get g_an. Flat portion ~5.8e-10 below ~4e-7 eV then rising; mass-dependent points are approximate reads of Fig 4. Also sets bounds on light spin-1 (V1,V2,V3), unparticles, and Lorentz-violating Goldstone bosons (Table I). | selector: text (sole candidate)
